changes: Replaces the active heuristic answer-band calibration with a reference-class Bayesian posterior.
Simulates annual material-event counts and per-event positive severities instead of LEF multiplied by one magnitude.
Produces joint scenario percentiles from shared posterior draws.
Adds one optional organisation evidence field: materialLossEventCount for the previous 12 months.
Integrates treatment-effect uncertainty across simulation iterations.
Discloses the actual in-memory assessment seed so Decision Lab can replay the same run.
Uses object-local MT19937 state and Wilson exceedance diagnostics.
Retains the 1.3 annualised-exposure engine only as a validated fallback when no active posterior package is available.
evidenceSources: IBM Cost of a Data Breach Report 2025 (large-enterprise sensitivity only)
knownLimitations: No independent organisation-level prospective loss dataset validates individual predictions.
Scenario composition is not identified by a source that covers all five annual rates.
National survey costs are perceived costs of the most disruptive incident, not audited annual total losses.
The model remains provisional and is not a forecast, guarantee, audit or compliance determination.
calibrationChangePolicy: Evidence, model code, posterior draws and validation gates are versioned together. A package may be active only when its calibration report is validated, non-synthetic and hash-verified.
